notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition Release Date Reveal
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Definitive Edition will be released on August 14, 2025!


The Definitive Edition will be available to purchase that same day for USD$29.99. Players who already own the Dawn of War – Anniversary Edition will receive a 30% upgrade discount on Steam and GOG. This discount for previous owners will remain in place for the foreseeable future. The team has been hard at work updating this classic experience for modern hardware, but in the meantime, check out the classic Dawn of War trailer, newly enhanced in 4K!  



Q: When is Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition coming out?  

A: August 14, 2025    



Q: What platforms will Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition be available for?  

A: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition will be available for PC on the Steam and GOG storefronts.   



 Q: How much will Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition cost?  

A: USD$29.99



Q: I own the Dawn of War – Anniversary Edition, do I get a discount?  

A: Yes! There will be a 30% discount for players who own the Anniversary Edition on Steam or GOG.   



Q: What languages will Dawn of War: Definitive Edition support? 

A: Most of the original translations for the game will be available at launch with the addition of full text support for Simplified Chinese. We’ll have more news on all the language options for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition closer to its release date. 



Q: Is the minimum recommended specification on the Steam Store page accurate?  

A: This is a conservative preliminary minimum specification. Further optimization during development will bring this down before launch.    



Q: Will you be adding any new content or post-launch DLC?  

A: No. Our focus is on delivering the ultimate Dawn of War experience when we launch the Definitive Edition later this year – that means everything players know and love from the original game all in one package. We’ll keep an eye out for any critical issues or bugs that need to be addressed after launch, but our primary goal is to optimize Dawn of War for modern hardware.    



Q: Will you be making any multiplayer balance changes or quality of life improvements? 

A: Though our primary focus is on updating the game for modern hardware, we have been keeping a close eye on your feedback. Multiplayer balance will mostly remain the same; however, we have been fixing some of the most egregious legacy bugs that should help improve the multiplayer experience. Though not all legacy bugs will be addressed for launch, we plan to be on standby to hot fix any high priority issues after the game’s official release. In addition to that, we are experimenting with changes to high impact items to improve general gameplay, such as the behavior of flying units or the pathing of infantry and vehicles, along with quality-of-life settings such as grid key presets.    



Q: Does this mean that we’ll also get a new version of Dawn of War 2 or any other Relic Entertainment games?  

A: We can only talk about games that we have announced. Right now, we’re focused on supporting the Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition and our other released and upcoming Relic games.    



Q: When will you share more information about the updates and improvements to the game?  

A: In the lead up to our August launch, we have lots to share from the development team in blogs, videos, and livestreams. Join the official Relic Entertainment Discord server to stay up to date on the latest.

notes.title: Patch Notes and a Quick Community Update
notes.notes:
Hello, fans! I wanted to take a quick moment to address our Dawn of War community and provide an update for you all!

First off, I'm very happy to announce that a minor patch that will be going out today. This update addresses a few technical issues, corrects some statistical anomalies and adds minor button functionality to our automatch completed game page.

In addition to this update, we also wanted to let everyone know that we will be building out our community team this year. We've shrunk in size here at Relic - from three people to one - and recognize that we need more assistance to better serve our Dawn of War community! We ask our fans for patience during this time, and are looking forward to introducing you to new staff as they come on!

Patch notes for today's update are as follows:

 Dawn of War 2 Titles 

Updated build:

ver. 2.6.10236                    Dawn of War 2

ver. 2.6.10236                    Dawn of War 2 Chaos Rising

ver. 3.19.1.10235              Dawn of War 2 Retribution


 
 1. WorldBuilder
 Resolved crash issues with the Worldbuilder when creating user generated maps.

2. Automatch

  Can now click “continue” after a ranked game is complete.

3. Statistics

  Corrected issue where stats were only being recorded when a player conceded or ended a game.

4. Statistics

  Corrected issue where some achievements would not unlock.

    • i.e. Primarch and other difficulty achievements.

    • i.e. Unlocking Last Stand war gear progression items.

5. Pause

  Pause/Break Key now functions for Single Player.

  Pause/Break Key during Replays now function.

6. Lobby/Chat

  Some behavior with Party Chat and General Chat have been adjusted.

   • i.e. Party Chat isn't automatically selected when entering a party/lobby if the general chat is already open.



 Dawn of War 1 Titles 


Updated build:

ver. 197807         Dawn of War Game of The Year / Winter Assault

ver. 197806         Dawn of War Dark Crusade

ver. 452                Dawn of War Soulstorm


1. Misc.

  Resolved some server exception issues.


This update will go live at approximately 11am pacific standard time. 

We look forward to a bright year for both the Dawn of War 1 and Dawn of War 2 communities!
